title: まあ、アイスでも食べようよ

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, you can't hog all the shade—it's against the law! I'm gonna find Teach and snitch on yooou! ☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Oh, Sky… What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nothing… just the best spot to eat some ice cream.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haven't I already told you the perfect place is a room chilled to perfection?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sometimes it's better to get that chilly kick in the sweltering heat.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Lies. You're just here to meddle. My test scores weren't so great, okay? Is that what you want to hear?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Five points down from your average is still great. High achievers like you hardly need my worry.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Five points is a big difference! Marks off over such a rudimentary mistake… This is not how a first-rate student should be.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But I won't be feeling sorry for myself. I'm already preparing for the next test, so—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My ice cream's all melty now… probably 'cause of you rambling on for so long. Welp, now you're taking me to the store to buy a replacement! ☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't put the blame on me! I'm not buying you anything! Sky, are you listening to me?!
